title: A Morning Surprise! 🐶🐅
text: Imagine waking up and finding a little puppy sitting at your door! But wait, could a tiger sit at your door too? Why do some animals live in our homes and others live in the deep, dark jungle?

title: Time to Think! 🤔
text: Have you ever wondered why we don't keep elephants as pets? What would happen if a big elephant tried to sleep on your bed?

content: Encourage students to mimic animal sounds to make the learning process fun and engaging! You can ask: 'What sound does a dog make?' or 'Can you roar like a lion?'

content.title: Animals in their Homes
content.description: See how the dog is happily sleeping in a house, while the lion is roaring in the jungle!

title: The Big Reveal! 🌟
text: Animals that live with us or on farms are called **Domestic Animals**. Animals that live in the forest are called **Wild Animals**.

content.definition: Animals that are tame and live with humans. We can keep them in our houses or on farms. Examples: dogs, cats, cows, and sheep.
Animals that live freely in nature, like forests, jungles, and oceans. Examples: lions, tigers, elephants, and sharks.

content: Some children think all big animals are wild animals. Remind them that cows and camels are very big, but they are domestic animals because they live with humans!

question: Which of these animals would you find living in a deep, dark jungle?

title: Your Turn to Share! 🗣️
text: Think about the animals you saw today. Were they domestic animals or wild animals? If you could be any animal for one day, which one would you be and why?

title: Connecting the Dots 🔗
text: Just like animals have homes (like the jungle or our houses), we have homes too! We will learn about the different types of homes people and animals build in our future lessons.

content.title: Mastery Challenge! 🎨
content.text: Draw a picture of your favorite animal! Is it a domestic animal or a wild animal? Ask your parents or teacher to help you write its name below the picture.
